messages.subject: Group Comparison for 3 sample groups
parts:
Hello!

I have 3 sample groups (control, control 2, and disease). How would I go about doing group comparison so as to do control/control2, control/disease, and control2/disease? Or perhaps my thought processes are incorrect?

The final aim is to do a power analysis with limiting sample size, if that will help with the analysis.

Thank you very much!

Kind regards,
Pavan

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Group Comparison for 3 sample groups
parts:
Hi,

to do this, you run the standard MSstats workflow and while using groupComparison function, you pass a contrast matrix of three comparisons: (1, -1, 0), (1, 0, -1), (0, 1, -1) [or you flip the signs] where first position corresponds to control, second to control2, third to disease.


Kind regards,
Mateusz
